id.description: kebab-case file name for this CV profile, e.g. science-communication. Lower case letters, digits and single hyphens only. Must not be one of the profile ids listed in the system prompt

description.description: One sentence. Shown in the picker, and given to the model that guesses a profile for a new advertisement, so it must say what kind of role this profile is for

register.description: How expert the reader of this application is assumed to be

evidenceProfiles.description: Which evidence tags this profile may draw records from. Only the tags listed in the system prompt exist. A plain string array, not an enum, and the server rejects anything that is not one of them

sections.description: The CV's sections, in the order they appear. Only the section ids listed in the system prompt exist; the server rejects any other id

id.description: A section id from the catalogue in the system prompt

heading.description: Wording that overrides the default heading, or null to keep it

max.description: Render at most this many entries in this section, or null for no limit

lengthPages.description: Page budget for the CV, or null when the profile has no page limit (an academic CV, for instance)

policy.description: omit = leave publications out; brief = a short relevant list; selected = the most relevant few; all = the complete list

count.description: How many to show. Ignored when policy is omit or all; use 0 for omit

style.description: one-line = a single line each; full = full citation form

clearance.description: How the security clearance is treated: lead with it, mention it where the ad raises security, or leave it out

techSectionName.description: What the technical section is called on the page, e.g. Skills, Technical Skills, Methods & Tools

kindPriority.description: How strongly each kind of evidence record leads in this profile. Higher wins; 0 to 6 is the range the existing profiles use

skillGroups.description: Optional. Groups the skills line under labels, e.g. Languages / Analysis / Tooling. Omit the whole array to run the skills together instead

prompt_markdown.description: The body of this profile's prompt file, in the same voice as the existing ones: a '# Profile: ...' heading, the section order, what leads and why, how publications and the clearance are treated, and what the technical section is called
